blocks.text: 21. The Folded Garden of Six Traditions

Real-world analogue: A botanical conservatory containing distinct climate houses, a mountain where several ecological zones meet, a reclaimed industrial landscape, and a river delta where incompatible land uses survive through careful water exchange.
World relation: All six World traditions are intentionally present. The place is not a seventh purified tradition; it is a negotiated survival environment.
Connection to newer locations: It is the conceptual center of the Obsidian Mangrove Delta, Patchwork Prairie of Broken Seasons, Skyfold Boundary, Mosaic Worldscar, and Valley That Restores Wrong.
Abstract or metaphorical relation: Visible seams can be evidence of care. Survival does not always mean returning pieces to their original separation or smoothing them into one uniform replacement.
